solution_summary: Nsure.com used Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure AI Foundry to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. The results were impressive: thanks to AI-driven automation through these new Power Platform tools, Nsure.com customer service representatives reduced time spent on manual tasks by more than 60%, allowing them to focus on complex escalations and building customer relationships. The architecture emphasizes managed services, reusable integrations, and governed data handling so the organization can scale adoption without rebuilding the solution for each new team or use case.
